conventions.convention: The exterior domain is R × (s,∞) × S², with c,G_N,m_*>0, s=2G_Nm_*/c², f=1-s/r, metric −f d(x⁰)²+f⁻¹dr²+r²γ, and time orientation ∂₀. Polar component displays exclude sphere poles.
Curvature uses R(X,Y)Z=∇_X∇_YZ−∇_Y∇_XZ−∇_[X,Y]Z, with R(∂c,∂d)∂b=Rᵃ_bcd∂a and Ric_bd=gᵃᶜR_abcd.
Timelike geodesics are parametrized by proper time τ, with g(U,U)=−c²; e=f dx⁰/dτ and ℓ=r²sin²ϑ dφ/dτ. Null circular curves instead use an affine parameter.

Circular-potential derivatives are taken at fixed angular momentum, and the circular value is substituted only afterward. Stability means the stated potential-extremum test; it is not a nonlinear stability claim.
The isotropic radius satisfies r=ρ(1+s/(4ρ))², with ρ>s/4. Large-radius expansions hold with fixed s>0.
The advanced extension has r>0, v=x⁰+r_*(r), r_*=r+s log|r/s−1| on separate nonhorizon branches, and metric −f dv²+2dv dr+r²γ.
Kruskal coordinates have UV<1, UV=(1−r/s)exp(r/s), g_UV=−2s³exp(−r/s)/r, and future orientation ∂U+∂V.
Escape means eventual residence in U<0<V with r→∞ along a future causal curve; it does not presuppose conformal infinity.
The local Birkhoff hypotheses include connected nonempty open V⊂R², det q<0, r>0, z=q⁻¹(dr,dr)≠0, and Ric(g)=0. The resulting constant s can have either sign.

The physical model adopts the direct Einstein equation with T=0 and Λ=0, together with ideal-clock, test-body and geometric-optics assumptions. Its deductions assert nothing about nature and use no measured inputs.
Observer energy is E=−c g(W,n); redshift is z=E_E/E_R−1. Positive constant rescaling of the affine null tangent leaves the ratio unchanged.
Countable choice AC_ω is assumed through the manifold-product and tangent-bundle suppliers; no further choice principle is claimed.

load_bearing.statement: For c,G_N,m_*>0 and s=2G_Nm_*/c², the exterior datum is M=R×(s,∞)×S² with g=−f d(x⁰)⊗d(x⁰)+f⁻¹dr⊗dr+r²ι*γ, f=1−s/r, and N=∂₀.
For the exterior datum, Ric=0, S=0 and G=0 globally; the global contraction g(R(∂₀,∂r)∂r,∂₀)=−s/r³ is nowhere zero.
Circular timelike geodesics exist precisely above r=3s/2; at their circular angular momentum, V''=c²s(r−3s)/(r³(2r−3s)). The constructed future null circular geodesics have r=3s/2.
n=f⁻¹/²∂₀ is a future unit timelike congruence with all-real constant-radius integral curves, Δτ=√f(r₀)Δt, and acceleration ∇_nn=s/(2r²)∂r.
The advanced-chart metric on R×(0,∞)×S² is smooth Lorentzian across r=s, contains the exterior isometrically, has Ric=S=G=0 and K=12s²/r⁶, and r=s is a smooth null hypersurface.

The implicit radial function is unique and smooth; the Kruskal metric is smooth Lorentzian and time-oriented, its four nonaxis regions have the stated branch isometries, and globally Ric=S=G=0 and K=12s²/r⁶.
For g=q+r²γ on V×S² with det q<0 and r>0, Ric_AB=Ric(q)_AB−2 Hess_AB(r)/r, Ric_Ai=0, and Ric_ij=(1−z−rΔ_qr)γ_ij.
Under the stated connected-base, nonzero-z and warped-vacuum hypotheses, Hess r=(Δ_qr/2)q, r(1−z)=s is constant, and K_A=ε_AB∂ᴮr obeys K(r)=0, q(K,K)=−z and ∇_AK_B+∇_BK_A=0.

Under the adopted framework postulates with the exterior datum, T=0 and Λ=0, the field law holds; ideal static clocks read Δτ=√f(r₀)Δt, and m_* has the stated circular-orbit and isotropic far-field parameter readings. These are conditional deductions asserting nothing about nature.

concerns.concern: Remarks, 'Units and the physical reading', states that x⁰ and r have length units, angular coordinates are dimensionless, and 'the metric coefficients are dimensionless'. This conflicts with its own g₂₂=r² and g₃₃=r²sin²ϑ, which have units m² in this mixed chart. The opened def-gr-si-unit-and-coordinate-conventions(b) explicitly says general-chart component dimensions follow the coordinate Jacobians.

Statement (d) asserts Δτ₁/Δτ₂=√(f(r₁)/f(r₂)) over 'the same coordinate interval Δx⁰' without requiring a nonzero increment. At Δx⁰=0, both increments vanish and the asserted quotient is undefined. Proof 3.1 divides without stating that condition. The same omission propagates to pthm-gr-schwarzschild-vacuum-model(b); the explicit clock example correctly requires Δt>0.

Statement (b) repeats the clock-increment quotient over 'the same coordinate interval' without a nonzero or positive duration hypothesis. For zero duration it asserts an undefined 0/0. This consumes the corresponding unrestricted quotient in lem-gr-schwarzschild-static-congruence-and-clock-rates(d).

Example clause 2 asserts (Wⁿ_ℓ)''(3s/2)=−32ℓ²/(81s⁴)<0 but never explicitly assumes ℓ≠0 for its null-potential data; its Given block also lacks that condition. At ℓ=0 the expression is zero and no nonzero null circular tangent results. The cited supplier lem-gr-schwarzschild-circular-orbits-and-photon-sphere(d) explicitly starts 'Let ℓ≠0'.

Statement (d), L4 and proof 4.2 call the two-dimensional base field Killing 'in the sense of def-gr-killing-field' and invoke thm-gr-killing-and-on-shell-matter-identities(a). Both opened suppliers have a Lorentzian four-manifold domain; the theorem additionally assumes orientation. The local calculation establishes the base symmetrized covariant derivative identity, but the dimension-two Lie-derivative definition/equivalence is not supplied explicitly. A short coordinate derivation would close this citation-domain gap and support its use in the Birkhoff proof.

L3 says that because R is a smooth tensor, 'a component identity proved in one chart holds in every chart'. Tensoriality gives a transformation law, not unchanged numerical component formulas in arbitrary charts. The invariant vanishing and scalar identities used later are valid; the quoted general component claim needs narrower wording. Similar wording appears in L3 of lem-gr-schwarzschild-curvature-and-kretschmann-scalar.

seams_checked.note: The mass reading uses the leading weak-field time coefficient and adopted comparison dictionary. It does not claim the full quantitative weak-field theorem or a realized Newtonian matter source.
The acceleration supplier defines a=∇_nn for a unit congruence; the static-congruence computation uses that normalization and does not claim a global energy or asymptotic mass.

Signature, causal classification, time orientation and model assumptions are preserved. The exterior definition's claim that all metric coefficients are dimensionless contradicts the supplier's mixed-coordinate unit convention; see the concern on def-gr-schwarzschild-exterior-model.

Connection existence, proper-time normalization, affine geodesic uniqueness and test-body/light-ray postulates retain their stated scope. The physical orbit theorem distinguishes actual histories from maximal mathematical continuations.
Observers remain future unit timelike vectors; congruences and tetrads are distinguished. The redshift proof uses E=−c g(W,n) and positivity for nonzero future causal W.

The curvature sign, slot order and contractions agree. L3 of the Ricci calculation nevertheless overstates tensoriality as preservation of component identities in every chart; see the presentation concern.

The direct field law, vacuum prescription and four-dimensional Killing-pairing uses are faithful. The warped-base reduction applies the four-dimensional Killing definition/equivalence to its two-dimensional base without an explicit local extension; see its concern.
The clock example uses the unit static congruence, and all acceleration values are explicitly coefficients of ∇_nn rather than unqualified measured SI accelerations.
The normalized Kruskal example divides metric and radial values by the declared length scale and preserves nonzero causal-vector and time-orientation conventions.

Opened def-gr-observation-and-analysis-architecture and rem-gr-primary-report-research-queue identify the stationary-redshift theorem only for static exterior observers. They accurately limit the orbit theorem to circular/photon-sphere content and leave eccentric advance, apparatus modelling and primary-report evidence unsupplied.
